messages:
support_jen: Hi team — Mira from Acme Retail just opened a dispute: their billing dashboard shows ~18k tokens for 2026-03-02 00:00–01:00 but the invoice shows 36k tokens. Customer insists they had no traffic. Can we confirm if this is a ledger duplication or a post-aggregation reclassification?

finance_liam: Thanks Jen. @eng_matt can you check ingestion side? My hunch: post-batch replay or double-apply of a batch window. If it's a ledger-side dedupe miss we should propose a provisional credit.

eng_matt: Looking now. Initial queries: ledger events for merchant_id=acme-retail between 2026-03-02T00:00Z and 2026-03-02T01:00Z show two sets of aggregate rows with identical request_ids. suspect replay from the postbatched aggregator.

eng_matt: Snippet from the audit query:
```
SELECT request_id, count(*) as hits, sum(tokens) as tok
FROM usage_events
WHERE merchant_id='acme-retail' AND event_time >= '2026-03-02T00:00:00Z' AND event_time < '2026-03-02T01:00:00Z'
GROUP BY request_id
HAVING count(*) > 1
LIMIT 10;
```
Result: 142 duplicated request_ids. total duplicate-token delta = 17,982

billing-bot: Automated alert: postbatched-processor v2.4.1 emitted retry marker header but dedupe consumer ignored it due to schema mismatch. See run id: run-20260302-00-agg.

support_jen: @customer_mira I've flagged this as a priority and requested provisional credit. Customer asked for ETA and a revrec note they can pass to accounting. Can we draft a concise revrec explanation for finance?

finance_liam: Draft revrec note for acme-retail: "Billing correction: On 2026-03-02, a post-aggregation replay resulted in duplicated ingest of 142 usage events, inflating token counts by 17,982 for the billing window 00:00–01:00 UTC. Redwood has applied a provisional credit to the March invoice pending final reconciliation. This adjustment will be recorded as a contra-revenue credit and reconciled in the March revenue recognition close. Contact billing@redwood.ai for details." Is that OK?

customer_mira: Thanks, that helps. Will you confirm provisional credit amount and timeline? We need it reflected before our month-end close (3/5).

finance_liam: Provisional credit approved for the token delta (17,982 tokens * rate from invoice = $1,439.10). Finance will post provisional credit today and include the revrec note in the invoice memo. Final reconciliation after dedupe patch verification will happen by 3/10.

eng_matt: Root cause summary: postbatched-processor v2.4.1 will re-enqueue aggregated files if upload confirmation times out. A schema change in the dedupe-consumer ignored the new retry_marker header introduced 2/22. Fix: accept either "retry_marker" or legacy "retry_id" header. Patch under review: PR #4821. Backfill plan: run a dedupe job to mark duplicate events and produce a reconciliation delta file.

support_jen: Steps for support desk: 1) Confirm provisional credit posted (finance). 2) Tell customer credit is visible on invoice and provide revrec note. 3) Follow up after eng backfill completes for final adjustment.

eng_matt: Quick repro for ops (internal):
```
# fetch candidate aggregates
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  "https://ingest.redwood.ai/internal/aggregates?run=run-20260302-00-agg" > /tmp/agg.json
# run dedupe check
python tools/check_duplicates.py /tmp/agg.json --match request_id
```
Found 142 matches, token delta matches ledger delta.

billing-bot: Action recorded: provisional_credit.posted by finance_liam at 2026-03-03T14:12:23Z (credit_id=pc-20260303-ACME-142).

finance_liam: @customer_mira provisional credit $1,439.10 has been applied. Invoice memo: "Provisional credit for duplicated usage events; final reconciliation pending." Let us know if you need a PDF copy for accounts payable. :calendar:

support_jen: Sending the revrec note and provisional credit confirmation now. Marking thread for follow-up on 2026-03-10 for final reconciliation.

customer_mira: Appreciate the quick response. Please share final reconciliation when ready.

eng_matt: PR #4821 merged and rolling out to prod canary. Backfill job scheduled for 2026-03-06 02:00 UTC. I'll post results here once complete.

finance_liam: Final note for records: revenue impact is contra-revenue in March; expected adjustment won’t change ARR guidance, this is an isolated processing issue.

support_jen: Closing loop for now. If anyone in ops/infra sees related alerts, ping this thread. :white_check_mark:
